[Animate.css](https://animate.style) is a stylesheet of ready-made CSS animations.
Using it in a Quarto document by hand means remembering the right pair of class names, wrapping the text in a span, and setting `display: inline-block` every time.

`animate` reduces that to one shortcode.
Name the effect, give it the text, and the extension writes the span, validates the timing, and loads the stylesheet.

## Installation

```bash
quarto add {{< var extension.reference >}}
```

This will install the extension under the `_extensions` subdirectory.
If you are using version control, you will want to check in this directory.

Or install it from your editor with [Quarto Wizard](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-wizard):

::: {.btn-group role="group" aria-label="Quarto Wizard installer options"}

[Visual Studio Code](vscode://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/install?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Install {{< var extension.reference >}} in Visual Studio Code using the Quarto Wizard extension."}
[Positron](positron://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/install?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Install {{< var extension.reference >}} in Positron using the Quarto Wizard extension."}
[VSCodium](vscodium://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/install?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Install {{< var extension.reference >}} in VSCodium using the Quarto Wizard extension."}

:::

## Quick start

The effect and the text are both required, and the text is quoted:

```markdown
{{{< animate bounce "Some text" >}}}
```

Which renders as {{< animate bounce "Some text" >}}.

Timing is set per call:

```markdown
{{{< animate tada "Some text" duration=2s repeat=3 >}}}
```

Which renders as {{< animate tada "Some text" duration=2s repeat=3 >}}.

Or once, for a whole document or project:

```yaml
extensions:
  animate:
    duration: 1s
    delay: 1s
    repeat: 1
```

See the [Reference](reference.qmd) for every option, and the [Examples](examples.qmd) for all ninety-odd effects rendered.

## Where it works

HTML formats that carry JavaScript, which covers `html` and `revealjs`.

::: {.callout-warning}
In every other format the shortcode produces nothing, and the text goes with it.
Nothing is left behind: the words are dropped from the PDF, the Word file, and the ePub.
Keep animated text decorative, or repeat it in prose that every format keeps.
:::
